approved_options.label: balanced
approved_options.summary: Ship M25+M26+M27+M28 together. M25 owns data model + CLI; M26 owns HTTP API + SSE; M27 owns canvas + DOM stub + cytoscape vendors; M28 owns side panel + ROADMAPS.md docs.
approved_options.trade_offs: Full user goal delivered (interactive roadmap canvas with drag-to-connect, inline edit, click-to-create, live SSE). All four milestones tested independently with regression gates; rollback per-milestone remains possible because each milestone owns disjoint files.

critic_notes: Plan is internally consistent and ready to advance past the ralplan gate. CR-DATA-LOSS structural fix is the load-bearing change and is complete: every code site (kanban/board.ts:278-292, :355-398, :319-347, :30-62, ok/schemas.ts:29/65/93, kanban/server.ts:667) that participates in the engine→planning→engine round-trip is enumerated with exact file:line references; the regression test exercises the precise failure mode that surfaced the original bug. All round-1 majors (CR-NAMING, CR-SSE-CLI, CR-TAB-LIST, CR-JSDOM) and round-1 minors (CR-DEFER-MISLABEL, CR-CLI-FORMAT, CR-EDGEHANDLES-STALE, CR-OK-MIGRATION-CONTENTION, CR-OBSERVER) are addressed with concrete gates. All 5 round-2 MINORs (field-name standardization, false rename claims, false flag reference, missing UX, missing position policy) and the 1 round-3 MINOR (CLI example inconsistency) are resolved. The 4 UNVERIFIED annotations are correctly placed for downstream confirmation. Sequence dependency: OK migration must land before M25 because both touch bin/ok.ts and ok/commands/.
